title: Litter Traps & Public Amenities: A Spatial Proximity and Network Analysis
name: Litter Traps & Public Amenities: A Spatial Proximity and Network Analysis
description: This use case examines the spatial relationships between litter traps and public amenities (BBQ areas and cafes) to understand and optimise maintenance and asset distribution, using proximity analysis, network robustness analysis, correlation, clustering, and a proof-of-concept classification model.
